records.original_stem:
Case A: An outsourcing facility relies on section 503B to supply eligible office-use stock and argues that it has the same cGMP exemption as qualifying section 503A preparations.

Case B: The facility tells purchasers that appearing in FDA's outsourcing-facility registration system means every compounded medicine it makes has individual FDA approval.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Outsourcing-facility registration does not constitute individual FDA approval of every compounded product.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 시설 등록과 제품 승인은 별개이며 개별 제품도 해당 조건을 충족해야 한다.

B.original_option_text: Federal permission to supply eligible office-use stock does not remove the need for a valid prescription when dispensing prescription drugs to an individual patient.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 시설 stock 공급과 실제 환자에게 prescription drug를 dispense하는 단계를 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: Federal outsourcing registration by itself establishes the required Massachusetts facility authority.
C.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 연방 등록과 주의 license·MCSR·inspection 조건을 함께 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Applicable Massachusetts facility authority remains a separate requirement from federal registration.

D.original_option_text: The described section 503B pathway remains subject to cGMP requirements.
D.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 503A와 503B의 면제 범위·품질 규제를 동일시하지 않는다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A section 503B facility proposes using a bulk substance merely because it has a certificate of analysis, without establishing a qualifying clinical-need or shortage pathway.

Case B: A third party proposes buying compounded drugs from the outsourcing facility for ordinary wholesale resale, rather than dispensing under patient prescriptions or administering in a healthcare setting.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Section 503B status removes restrictions concerning copies and drugs withdrawn for safety reasons.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 등록이 개별 제품에 적용되는 추가 금지·제한을 없애지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Essentially-copy and unsafe-or-ineffective withdrawal restrictions remain relevant to eligibility.

B.original_option_text: The patient-dispensing exception permits any purchaser to engage in ordinary wholesale resale.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 503B 재판매 제한과 적법한 patient dispensing·healthcare administration을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: The ordinary wholesale-resale plan is not justified by the described patient-dispensing or healthcare-administration pathways.

C.original_option_text: A shortage at any historical time is sufficient for all later compounding, distribution, and dispensing.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 해당 경로가 요구하는 compounding·distribution·dispensing 시점을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Where shortage status is the qualifying basis, the relevant statutory timing conditions must be evaluated.

D.original_option_text: The certificate does not replace the bulk-substance eligibility conditions for section 503B.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 503B의 bulk eligibility 경로와 COA·제조자·compendial 조건을 별도로 충족한다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: An outsourcing facility submits its annual registration in the October 1 through December 31 window and assumes that no separate drug-product report is required.

Case B: The facility supplies a preparation without a patient-specific prescription, but its label omits the applicable Office Use Only and Not for Resale statements.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Product reports are limited to products that already have individual FDA marketing approval.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 503B product reporting을 approved-product 목록 제출로 축소하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Product reports concern drugs compounded in the applicable preceding reporting period.

B.original_option_text: A facility registration number substitutes for the described office-use and resale statements.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 503B의 해당 label·container 요건을 제품 공급 경로에 맞게 확인한다.
교정된 설명: The label must be evaluated for the applicable Office Use Only and Not for Resale requirements.

C.original_option_text: Annual registration and the separate initial and June/December product-reporting obligations are distinct.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 시설 annual registration와 직전 기간의 drug reporting은 다른 제출물이다.

D.original_option_text: A compounded-drug statement makes lot and storage information unnecessary.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Compounded 표시가 나머지 추적·사용정보를 대신하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Lot identification, preparation timing, and required storage information remain part of applicable labeling assessment.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A Massachusetts resident outsourcing facility has provisional status under a pathway allowing preparation while the required FDA inspection and full approval remain outstanding.

Case B: A nonresident outsourcing supplier presents its federal registration listing as the only evidence that it may supply Massachusetts.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Completing federal annual registration necessarily renews the Massachusetts authorization.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 연방·주의 서로 다른 갱신 체계를 한 번의 제출로 처리하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: State renewal timing and federal annual registration may require separate calendars.

B.original_option_text: The provisional preparation pathway does not itself authorize distribution or dispensing before the required inspection and full approval.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Provisional에서 허용된 preparation과 full authority가 필요한 출고를 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: An existing authorization transfers to a new address without applicable relocation review.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 사업장 주소 변경과 검사·승인·신청 시점을 별도로 관리한다.
교정된 설명: A relocation must follow the applicable advance application and new-location approval requirements.

D.original_option_text: The federal listing alone establishes the described nonresident Massachusetts supply authority.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. FDA 공개 등록명부의 존재와 MA에서 공급할 자격은 같지 않다.
교정된 설명: The nonresident supplier must establish applicable Massachusetts approval and relevant home-state and inspection conditions.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A sponsor has an investigational new drug pathway for clinical research and describes it to a retail pharmacy as approval to market the product for routine patient prescriptions.

Case B: A different product has an approved ANDA, and staff assume this permits substituting it for products with other routes and release formulations without a product-specific interchange assessment.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: An IND-related research pathway is not the same as marketing approval for routine retail sale.
A.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 연구용 사용·운송 경로와 일반 판매승인을 분리한다.

B.original_option_text: A BLA is the individual dispensing pharmacist's professional license.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. BLA·NDA·ANDA·IND가 답하는 규제 질문을 구별한다.
교정된 설명: A BLA is the licensing application pathway for biological products, rather than a pharmacy's professional license.

C.original_option_text: ANDA approval establishes pharmacist substitution across all routes and release formulations of the ingredient.
C.original_rationale_ko:

A.original_option_text: An EUA removes the need to check the authorized population and conditions of use.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. EUA는 정식 승인과 별도 경로이며 대상·조건·유효 상태가 중요하다.
교정된 설명: An EUA must be evaluated for its scope and current conditions rather than treated as unrestricted full approval.

B.original_option_text: An approved product's off-label use creates general independent prescribing authority for pharmacists.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 약물 사용 판단과 직종의 법적 scope·처방권한은 다른 층이다.
교정된 설명: Off-label use of an approved product does not create new pharmacist prescribing authority.

C.original_option_text: Every OTC medicine is marketed through the monograph pathway and none through an approved application.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. OTC라는 판매 구분만으로 승인 경로를 하나로 단정하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: An OTC medicine may follow an application pathway or an applicable monograph pathway.

Case A: A dispenser qualifies for a documented exemption covering specified enhanced DSCSA requirements during a defined period.

Case B: The dispenser therefore proposes purchasing from unqualified suppliers and dispensing suspect products without investigation, although those obligations are not among the exempted requirements.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Submitting an exemption request has the same effect as receiving a currently effective exemption.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 신청·제안·시행된 결정의 상태를 분리한다. 이 문항은 변동 가능한 연장 날짜 자체를 묻지 않는다.
교정된 설명: A proposed or requested exemption is not equivalent to an effective exemption already granted.

B.original_option_text: The specified enhanced-requirement exemption also waives the unrelated supplier and suspect-product duties.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Enhanced 요건의 한정 면제와 기본 공급망 의무를 구별한다.
교정된 설명: The described exemption does not justify ignoring remaining trading-partner and suspect-product duties.

C.original_option_text: The dispenser must identify precisely which requirements and time period the exemption covers.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 대상 entity·면제되는 구체적 요건·기간을 따로 확인한다.

D.original_option_text: Describing the pharmacy as small establishes eligibility without applying the actual criteria.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Small이라는 일상적 명칭이 해당 기준일·직원수·대상 정의의 증거는 아니다.
교정된 설명: An exemption's eligibility criteria must be established rather than inferred from the business calling itself small.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy receives a package with a product identifier but has not confirmed that the supplier qualifies as an authorized trading partner for the transaction.

Case B: A covered transaction's tracing records are scheduled for destruction after two years solely because staff remember a general pharmacy-record minimum.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A transaction between two pharmacies is exempt without assessing its purpose or applicable conditions.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 약국끼리 거래한다는 사실만으로 모든 거래 예외를 확정하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: A transaction-specific exception requires evaluation of its actual conditions.

B.original_option_text: The package identifier does not replace verification of the trading partner's applicable qualification.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 제품 식별자와 공급자 자격은 별도 정보다.

C.original_option_text: Traceability information provides the legal authority for a patient's prescription without a prescriber order.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 공급망 식별과 환자별 처방의 적법성은 다른 점검이다.
교정된 설명: Lot, serial, expiration, and product-identification information serve traceability functions rather than patient-prescription authorization.

D.original_option_text: The general two-year pharmacy-record minimum replaces the described DSCSA six-year requirement.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. DSCSA 기록 보존과 일반 처방·구매 기록의 minimum을 혼동하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The described DSCSA transaction records have their own six-year retention requirement.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A manufacturer removes a marketed product for a violation that would support FDA legal action and describes the action as a routine commercial withdrawal.

Case B: Another manufacturer retrieves a lot still entirely under its direct control; none of that lot has been released for sale or use.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A recall-related correction requires physical transport of every affected product.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Relabeling·repair·inspection 등 현장 correction도 개념상 가능하다.
교정된 설명: A correction can occur without physically moving a product to a new location.

B.original_option_text: The second situation is necessarily a patient-level recall even though none of the lot was released.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Stock recovery는 아직 판매·사용을 위해 release되지 않은 lot와 직접 통제 조건을 포함한다.
교정된 설명: The second situation fits the described stock-recovery concept because no part of the lot has been released for sale or use.

C.original_option_text: Classifying an action as non-recall eliminates any other patient-safety or reporting obligation.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. FDA 분류와 별도 Board 보고·환자 보호 의무를 각각 판단한다.
교정된 설명: A non-recall classification does not itself eliminate patient-safety or other reporting duties arising from the facts.

D.original_option_text: The first action fits the described recall concept rather than becoming a market withdrawal merely through the firm's chosen label.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 명칭보다 marketed 여부와 법적 조치 대상 위반 등 실제 조건을 확인한다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A company begins a recall and notifies the pharmacy before FDA assigns a risk classification. Staff plan to continue dispensing the affected lot until a class appears.

Case B: A separate recalled product is classified as Class III, and a technician assumes the pharmacy can disregard the recall because serious harm is unlikely.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Class III makes compliance with the recall instructions optional.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 위험 가능성이 낮다는 분류와 회수 지시 이행은 다른 판단이다.
교정된 설명: Class III's lower expected health risk does not authorize disregarding the recall.

B.original_option_text: Class I means a low probability of any health consequence and is the least serious category.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Recall Class I을 Class III 또는 controlled-substance Schedule I과 혼동하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Class I concerns a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences or death.

C.original_option_text: Lack of a completed FDA classification does not justify continuing to dispense the affected lot contrary to the recall instructions.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Recall initiation과 FDA classification이 같은 날일 필요는 없다. Not yet classified도 조치가 필요할 수 있다.

D.original_option_text: The recall class alone identifies which patients received the affected lot.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Risk class는 위험 구분이며 실제 lot·환자·배송 경로는 별도 추적한다.
교정된 설명: Lot identification and distribution history remain necessary regardless of the risk class.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A company begins a recall and notifies the pharmacy before FDA assigns a risk classification. Staff plan to continue dispensing the affected lot until a class appears.

Case B: A separate recalled product is classified as Class III, and a technician assumes the pharmacy can disregard the recall because serious harm is unlikely.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: Lack of a completed FDA classification does not justify continuing to dispense the affected lot contrary to the recall instructions.
A.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Recall initiation과 FDA classification이 같은 날일 필요는 없다. Not yet classified도 조치가 필요할 수 있다.

B.original_option_text: Class III makes compliance with the recall instructions optional.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 위험 가능성이 낮다는 분류와 회수 지시 이행은 다른 판단이다.
교정된 설명: Class III's lower expected health risk does not authorize disregarding the recall.

C.original_option_text: Class I concerns a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences or death.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Recall Class I을 Class III 또는 controlled-substance Schedule I과 혼동하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: Lot identification and distribution history remain necessary regardless of the risk class.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Risk class는 위험 구분이며 실제 lot·환자·배송 경로는 별도 추적한다.

proposed_option_replacement.original_text: A relocation must follow the applicable advance application and new-location approval requirements.
proposed_option_replacement.new_text: The facility may distribute from a new address before Board relocation approval if its federal registration is current.

proposed_option_replacement.original_text: The package identifier does not replace verification of the trading partner's applicable qualification.
proposed_option_replacement.new_text: A package's product identifier establishes that its supplier is an authorized trading partner for the transaction.
